title: Impacted into Subspace (Standard)
description: This file is an improvisation that I recorded live. Relax into your breathing, and let go of your thoughts. Sink away as I introduce you to my favorite way to take a sub down into Trance using a kinaesthetic technique, and a new tool or two that I picked up from the latest convention I visited this week. I just love leather, leather paddles, leather whips. As I guide you through my thought process of making you melt under my fingertips. Conditioning your mind to produce these happy little spikes of adrenaline and dopamine with each and every thwack I subject you to.
author: Mistress Shibby
